Rscript - <<'RS'
df <- read.csv('/data/rec_data_raw.csv')
cat('US sampled:', sum(df$country=='us' & !is.na(df$expenditure_rank)), '\n')
cat('UK sampled:', sum(df$country=='uk' & !is.na(df$expenditure_rank)), '\n')
cat('US nrows filtered:', nrow(subset(df, country=='us' & !is.na(expenditure_rank))), '\n')
cat('UK nrows filtered:', nrow(subset(df, country=='uk' & !is.na(expenditure_rank))), '\n')
RS
